name: reviewadapters-kit
description: Run an optional reviewer model (Antigravity agy, Pi pi or Devin devin) on a diff, with the diff inline and no tools, and get codex-kit's validated findings envelope back, so a review pipeline such as cross-model-review can add a third or fourth vendor beside Claude and Codex. One dispatch contract for callers and CI, plus a command that reviews the current diff with one vendor after an egress confirmation. Every vendor is off until enabled in an untracked local allow-list.
